Glowgate (named after Glow from the Frost series and the -gate scandal suffix) is a dispute about clips on Tube that were labelled as safe.

  1. Doe, Jane (2017). Tube bans the odd channel. Daily. Archived from the original on 19 January 2018. Retrieved 25 January 2018.
  2. Roe, Sam (2017-12-08). Inside the odd clip war. Verge. Archived from the original on 2018-04-13. Retrieved 2018-05-01.
  3. Poe, Ben (9 November 2017). Tube says it will act. Verge. Archived from the original on 2017-11-16. In August, Tube said it would stop paying for such clips.
